title: Woman Goes Nuts After Failed Robbery Attempt
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 16th, 2022. Officers were dispatched in regards to a woman who attempted to rob a phone store for an iPhone charger. When the officers approached her, she was immediately uncooperative and tried to leave multiple times, the officers were then forced to use a taser on her. When she was finally apprehended, she kept yelling and saying she was pregnant, and being very rude to officers in the back of the squad car. At some point she even started twerking. This is footage of the events that followed.
